text: These are the two tenets of Nomai philosophy; to seek out and to understand is our way of living.
translation: 挪麦人信奉两大人生信条；寻找和理解是我们生命的意义
author: Solanum

translation: 离开这鬼地方，当一个顶天立地的人。
author: Arthur Morgan

text: So far as the theories of mathematics are about reality, they are not certain; so far as they are certain, they are not about reality.
translation: 数学法则只要与现实有关，都是不确定的；若是确定的，都与现实无关。
author: Albert Einstein
